map.输入各用电器电流与发电机额定电流，计算总负载、负载率并判断电气系统是否平衡。: Enter the current of each consumer and the alternator's rated current to compute total load and load factor, judging whether the electrical system is balanced.
map.用电总电流 = Σ各用电器电流: Total consumer current = Σ individual consumer currents
map.含充电总电流 = 用电总电流 + 电池充电电流: Total current including charging = consumer current + battery charging current
map.负载率 = 含充电总电流 ÷ 发电机额定电流 × 100%: Load factor = total current including charging ÷ alternator rated current × 100%
map.用电功率 = 用电总电流 × 系统电压: Consumer power = total consumer current × system voltage
map.发电机功率 = 发电机额定电流 × 系统电压: Alternator power = alternator rated current × system voltage
map.说明：安全负载率 < 80%、警戒线 90%；超过 90% 电池长期亏电。剩余电: Note: the safe load factor is below 80% with 90% the warning line; above 90% the battery stays chronically undercharged. Remaining current = alternator rated current − total current including charging, showing whether alternator capacity needs upgrading.
map.💡 总负载率 = (用电总电流+充电电流) ÷ 发电机额定电流 × 100%；安: 💡 Total load factor = (consumer current + charging current) ÷ alternator rated current × 100%; the safe load factor should stay below 80%
map.负载率超过 90% 时电池长期亏电，影响寿命: Above a 90% load factor the battery stays chronically discharged, shortening its life
map.夜间行驶（大灯+空调+雨刮）是最大负载工况: Night driving (headlights + air conditioning + wipers) is the heaviest load case

map.📚 深度解析：车载 12V 电压系统检测: 📚 In-depth: Testing the 12 V Vehicle Electrical System
map.用万用表测电瓶静止电压判断是否亏电，测启动瞬间压降判断电瓶与起动机。: Measure battery resting voltage with a multimeter to judge discharge, and the cranking voltage drop to judge battery and starter.
map.发动机运转时测发电机输出电压，确认充电正常（约 13.8–14.8V）。: With the engine running, measure alternator output to confirm charging (about 13.8–14.8V).
map.加装大功率电器前核算系统带载余量，防止亏电。: Before adding high-power accessories, work out the system's load headroom to avoid a flat battery.
map.满电静止电瓶≈12.6V，低于 12.0V 为亏电、低于 10.5V 难启动。运: A fully charged battery rests near 12.6V, below 12.0V it is discharged and below 10.5V starting becomes hard. With the engine running, output of 13.8–14.8V means it is charging; only 12.5V usually means a slack belt or failed regulator. A momentary dip to 9–10V while cranking is normal.
map.为什么发动着车电压更高？: Why is voltage higher once the engine is running?
map.发电机需高于电瓶电压才能充电，13.8–14.8V 是典型充电电压。低于此说明不: The alternator must exceed battery voltage to charge, and 13.8–14.8V is the typical charging range. Below that it is not charging and the battery drains further as you drive.
map.电瓶经常亏电怎么办？: The battery keeps going flat - what should I do?
map.查漏电（休眠电流应<50mA）、发电机输出与电瓶健康度，长期短途可定期满充，老化: Check for a parasitic draw (sleep current should be <50mA), alternator output and battery health; charge fully periodically if you only make short trips, and replace an aged battery in good time.
